about: Showcase models (D1): models the user can review on the showcase page and race against. The `default` entry is the game's bundled model (AI v2 since 2026-11-14, see doc/model-release.md); promotion into packages/server/src/ai/models/ is by hand, after real races. Exam v2 numbers are the training run's own exam (102 races: demo, short, 100 random tracks; seed 1; 180 s) at that generation; skills are `npm run skills` (8 episodes per skill, seed 1).
